expo.name: Enatega Delivery Platform
expo.description: Unified delivery platform: rider (GPS tracking, order acceptance) and store (catalog, order management) in a single app, merged from the enatega-multivendor-rider and enatega-multivendor-store apps.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: This app uses your precise location during active deliveries so customers and dispatchers can follow delivery progress even when the app is not in use.

plugins.photosPermission: The app accesses your photos for license, vehicle plate, product and profile images. Please allow these to continue using the app.

infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: $(PRODUCT_NAME) uses your precise location to support pickup, delivery navigation, and tracking orders nearby.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: $(PRODUCT_NAME) shares your precise location during active deliveries so customers and dispatchers can follow delivery progress even when the app is not in use.
